name: IceCream Elementor Addon
author: Reza Masoumpour

sections.description:
IceCream Elementor Addon is a collection of creative, responsive Elementor widgets for WordPress websites.

All widgets are available in the IceCream Elementor Addon category inside the Elementor editor. Widgets can be enabled or disabled from the plugin dashboard without editing code.

Dashboard Settings

Open IceCream Elementor Addon from the WordPress admin menu to:

  • Enable or disable individual Elementor widgets.
  • Manage widgets in Creative, Content, and Team sections.
  • Save settings with AJAX without refreshing the page.
  • See live enabled-widget counters.
  • Request custom Elementor widgets or plugin services through the custom-service CTA.

All widgets are enabled by default.

Widgets

Expand Button

Create an expanding button with:

  • Editable button text and link.
  • External-link and nofollow options.
  • Left or right expanding direction.
  • Selectable Elementor icon.
  • Button and hover background colors.
  • Text and hover colors.
  • Icon color, size, and typography controls.

Image 1

Create an image card with hover-revealed content:

  • Image, title, description, and accessible alt text.
  • Left, center, or right content alignment.
  • Image border radius.
  • Configurable image movement on hover and keyboard focus.
  • Title and description colors.
  • Separate typography controls for title and description.

Menu Image

Create an image with a sliding menu revealed on hover:

  • Custom image and alt text.
  • Unlimited repeater menu items.
  • Editable item titles, links, colors, external links, and nofollow settings.
  • Menu background and image-hover background colors.
  • Menu typography controls.
  • Multiple instances can be used safely on the same page.

Image Gallery

Create a responsive mosaic image gallery:

  • Elementor gallery image selector.
  • Deterministic mosaic layout that does not randomly change on every render.
  • Configurable grid gap.
  • Configurable row height.
  • Configurable card border radius.
  • Responsive desktop and mobile layout.
  • Image accessibility labels where available.

Post Grid

Display WordPress posts in an editorial card grid:

  • Query published posts by category.
  • Choose post count, order, and sorting method.
  • Responsive one-, two-, three-, or four-column layout.
  • Featured images with fallback backgrounds.
  • Category badges and reading-time badges.
  • Relative post dates.
  • Editable excerpts and excerpt length.
  • Author avatars and author names.
  • Comment counts.
  • Numbered pagination.
  • Progress footer showing displayed and total stories.
  • Load-more link to the next page.
  • Individual visibility controls for image, category, date, excerpt, author, comments, reading time, progress, and pagination.
  • Separate Elementor style sections for layout, card, image, category, reading time, metadata, title, excerpt, author, avatar, comments, progress, load-more, and pagination styling.

Timeline 1

Create an alternating vertical timeline:

  • Unlimited repeater timeline items.
  • Editable date, title, description, icon, card side, and link per item.
  • Alternating left/right cards by default.
  • Center timeline line with circular icon nodes.
  • Responsive mobile stacking.
  • Editable item spacing and card width.
  • Editable line color, line width, node size, and icon color.
  • Separate card background, border radius, shadow, and padding controls.
  • Separate date, title, and description colors and typography controls.

Team 1

Create a team member card with:

  • Image, name, and position controls.
  • Six social links and icons.
  • Hover social-icon animation.
  • Image hover overlay color.
  • Image border radius.
  • Name and position typography, color, alignment, and margin controls.
  • Social icon color, hover color, size, padding, and margin controls.

Team 2

Create a team member card with overlay details:

  • Image, name, and position controls.
  • Six social links and icons.
  • Overlay background and border-radius controls.
  • Image border radius.
  • Name and position typography, color, alignment, and margin controls.
  • Social icon alignment, color, hover color, size, padding, and margin controls.
  • Support for both font-based and SVG Elementor icons.

Team 3

Create a direction-based team member layout:

  • Image, name, position, and description controls.
  • Six social links and icons.
  • Responsive row, reverse-row, or column direction.
  • Image and details width controls.
  • Optional configurable card border.
  • Optional content-order switching for name, title, description, and social links.
  • Image radius and margin controls.
  • Separate name, position, description, and icon styling.

Team 4 – Big

Create a large team card with positioned overlay details:

  • Image, name, and position controls.
  • Six social links and icons.
  • Horizontal and vertical overlay positioning.
  • Name and position typography, color, alignment, and margin controls.
  • Social icon alignment, color, hover color, size, padding, and margin controls.
  • Image sizing and radius controls.

Team 5 – Fluid

Create a fluid team card with animated details:

  • Image, name, and position controls.
  • Six social links and icons.
  • Configurable details overlay movement.
  • Optional content-order switching.
  • Image radius and margin controls.
  • Name and position typography, color, alignment, and margin controls.
  • Social icon color, hover color, size, padding, and margin controls.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or later.
  • Elementor installed and active.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.

Elementor is declared as a required plugin. WordPress will prevent activation of IceCream Elementor Addon until Elementor is installed and active.
sections.faq:
How do I enable or disable widgets?

Open IceCream Elementor Addon in the WordPress dashboard, select the widgets you need, and click Save changes. The settings are saved with AJAX and the Elementor widget list uses the selected widgets.

I changed a widget style but do not see the change. What should I do?

Regenerate Elementor CSS from Elementor > Tools > Regenerate CSS & Data, then clear any page or site cache.

Can I use multiple instances of the widgets on one page?

Yes. The widgets use Elementor wrapper selectors and avoid shared element IDs where multiple instances could conflict.

Can I request a custom widget or feature?

Use the custom-service button in the plugin dashboard or visit:

https://flexypress.com/request-service/
sections.changelog:
3.0 – 12-09-2026

  • Added Post Grid widget with query, content, pagination, and detailed style controls.
  • Added Timeline 1 widget with repeater items and responsive alternating layout.
  • Added dashboard widget management with grouped sections and AJAX saving.
  • Added Elementor dependency declaration.
  • Improved widget accessibility, links, image alt text, SVG icon styling, and responsive behavior.
  • Added modern dashboard design and custom-service CTA.

2.0 – 30-10-2024

  • Restructured the plugin and widgets.
  • Improved compatibility with WordPress and Elementor.

1.2.0 – 26-04-2023

  • Added compatibility with WordPress and Elementor updates.
  • Added five team member widgets.

1.0.1 – 06-05-2022

  • Added a new Elementor widget.

1.0.0 – 20-04-2022

  • Initial release.
